item.title: ACTEC Announces New Law Journal Editors
item.description: ACTEC today announced the 2024–2026 Editors of the ACTEC Law Journal. The post ACTEC Announces New Law Journal Editors appeared first on The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel.

item.title: ACTEC Releases 300th Podcast in the ACTEC Trust and Estate Talk Series
item.description: ACTEC released its 300th podcast in the ACTEC Trust and Estate Talk series, titled "Estate Planning in 2024." ACTEC Fellow and Past President Stephen R. Akers of Dallas, Texas, delivers this special podcast, discussing key issues in estate planning in 2024. The post ACTEC Releases 300th Podcast in the ACTEC Trust and Estate Talk Series appeared first on The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel.

item.title: ACTEC Elects 32 New Fellows to The College
item.description: The College is pleased to announce 35 newly elected individuals, including 27 Fellows, 4 International Fellows and one Academic Fellow The post ACTEC Elects 32 New Fellows to The College appeared first on The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel.

item.title: ACTEC Capital Letters, ACTEC Honors Ronald D. Aucutt and Welcomes Beth Shapiro Kaufman
item.description: The College today announced that ACTEC Past President Ronald D. Aucutt (2003–2004) is stepping down as the author of Capital Letters. ACTEC Fellow Beth Shapiro Kaufman will succeed Aucutt in this esteemed role The post ACTEC Capital Letters, ACTEC Honors Ronald D. Aucutt and Welcomes Beth Shapiro Kaufman appeared first on The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel.

item.title: ACTEC Elects New Member to the Board of Regents
item.description: ACTEC today announced that a new Regent were elected to its Board of Regents during the College’s Annual Business Meeting, held in La Quinta, California, on Friday, March 21, 2025. The post ACTEC Elects New Member to the Board of Regents appeared first on The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel.

item.title: ACTEC Announces Peter S. Gordon as New President
item.description: ACTEC today announced that Peter S. Gordon will serve as the 2025–2026 President. Gordon is a Director at Gordon, Fournaris & Mammarella, P.A. in Wilmington, Delaware. He succeeds 2024–2025 ACTEC President Susan D. Snyder, a Senior Planner on Northern Trust’s Regional Wealth Advisor Team in Chicago, Illinois. The post ACTEC Announces Peter S. Gordon as New President appeared first on The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel.

item.title: The ACTEC Foundation Announces 2025–2026 Officers and Directors
item.description: The ACTEC Foundation today announced the 2025–2026 Foundation Officers and the four new Directors elected to The Foundation’s Board on Saturday, March 22, during the ACTEC 2025 Annual Meeting in La Quinta, CA. The post The ACTEC Foundation Announces 2025–2026 Officers and Directors appeared first on The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel.

item.title: ACTEC Elects 34 New Fellows to The College
item.description: The College is pleased to announce that 34 individuals were elected: 26 Fellows, one Academic Fellow, three Fiduciary Counsel Fellows, two International Fellows from Canada, one International Fellow from Japan, and Russell N. James, III, Professor of Charitable Financial Planning at Texas Tech University, was elected as an Honorary Fellow. The post ACTEC Elects 34 New Fellows to The College appeared first on The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel.

item.title: The ACTEC Foundation Announces the 2025–2027 Dennis I. Belcher Young Leaders
item.description: The College & Foundation are pleased to announce the Eleventh Class of Dennis I. Belcher Young Leaders. The post The ACTEC Foundation Announces the 2025–2027 Dennis I. Belcher Young Leaders appeared first on The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel.

item.title: ACTEC Elects 51 New Fellows to The College
item.description: The College is pleased to announce that 51 individuals were elected: 48 Fellows, one Academic Fellow, one International Fellow from Canada, and one International Fellow from the United Kingdom. The post ACTEC Elects 51 New Fellows to The College appeared first on The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel.
